name: tr_shead
caption:
IF JAMAL SHEAD WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

⚔️ Aegislash, sword and shield: Big 12 Player and Defensive Player of the Year in one season, the first ever to win both
👻 Haunter, the trade: pick 45 to Sacramento, traded to us that same night
🥚 Happiny, the giver: 307 assists as a rookie, 2nd most by a rookie in our history
🐍 Steelix, the iron man: all 82 games last season
🦅 Xatu, the vision: 16 assists in our win at Milwaukee
🔥 Infernape, the ace: 6.6 assists a night through 9 games, and a new 3-year extension

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: 2023-24 (Houston, Big 12): Big 12 Player of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year, the first player to win both awards in the same season; 2024 NBA draft: selected 45th overall by the Sacramento Kings, traded on draft night to Toronto; rookie year 307 total assists, second (2nd) among rookies in franchise history; appeared in all 82 games in 2025-26; October 1, 2026: three-year (3-year) contract extension
